description: Why: while the overflow year is far in the future, silent narrowing casts from u64 to i64 are an anti-pattern in Rust that can be caught at compile time with a checked cast. What: audit_log.rs stores ingested_at_ms (u64) and gc_at_ms (u64) by casting to i64 with as i64 before binding to sqlx. If the value exceeds i64::MAX the cast wraps silently, storing a negative timestamp. Use i64::try_from(val).unwrap_or(i64::MAX) or assert the value fits before the cast.
title: audit_log i64 cast from u64 ingested_at_ms silently truncates after year 292M
